title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS FIRST, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT PUSH AND CORE. FLEXIBILITY FIRST. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT PUSH AND CORE. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE DONE. CHEST OPEN. CORE HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR CHEST OPENER AFTER THE DESK. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE CHEST. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET PLANTED. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. HIP OPENER AFTER THAT CHAIR. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT ARCH YOUR BACK LIKE A BLOODY BANANA.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: FIFTH STEP. HANDS ON THE STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER CHEST TOWARD THE STEP. PRESS UP CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR LIGHT PUSH. DO NOT DROP TO A LOWER STEP.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. FIFTH STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER AND PRESS CLEAN. LIGHT PUSH. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE IT OUT. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. ARMS UP. KNEES BENT. PRESS THE LOW BACK INTO THE FLOOR. EXTEND OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG SLOW. CORE BRACED. NO ARCHING.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW AND CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR CORE. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY BEETLE ON ITS BACK.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. STACK THE SHOULDERS. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD. DO NOT SAG LIKE A BLOODY HAMMOCK.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN SHORT AND CLEAN. STEADY PACE. ARMS BRACE. CORE WORKS. LIGHT FINISH. NO FLOPPY HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN. STEADY PACE. LIGHT FINISH. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SEAL ON A ROCK.
exercises.speakDone: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
